cues.pisada: Stand on the band with both feet and hold it firmly.
cues.altura: Raise in front of you to shoulder height.
cues.bajada: Lower slowly, don't let the band pull you.

errores.balanceo: Swinging your torso to stretch the band.
errores.soltar: Letting the band snap back on the way down.

cues.altura: Raise the bar in front of you to shoulder height.
cues.ligera: Use a light bar: straight arms multiply the effort.

errores.balanceo: Swinging your torso to lift the bar.
errores.codos: Bending your elbows to shorten the lever.

cues.codo: Elbows nearly straight; lead with your elbow, not your hand.
cues.altura: Raise to shoulder height, no higher.
cues.banda: Stand on the band with both feet and pick a tension you control.

errores.soltar: Letting the band yank your arms down.
errores.trapecio: Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears as you lift.

cues.altura: Raise in front of you to shoulder height.
cues.bajada: Lower slowly, over about two seconds.

errores.balanceo: Swinging your torso to lift the weight.
errores.alto: Raising your hands above your head.

cues.codo: Elbows nearly straight; lead with your elbow, not your hand.
cues.altura: Raise to shoulder height, no higher.
cues.peso: Light, controlled weight: if you swing, go lighter.

errores.balanceo: Swinging your torso to lift the dumbbells.
errores.trapecio: Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears as you lift.

cues.codo: Elbows nearly straight; lead with your elbow, not your hand.
cues.altura: Raise to shoulder height, no higher.
cues.peso: Light weight: seated, there's no momentum to help.

errores.alto: Raising your hands above your shoulders.
errores.trapecio: Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears as you lift.

cues.codos: Pull toward your face with elbows high and wide.
cues.giro: At the end, hands beside your ears, palms facing forward.
cues.pausa: Hold for a second at the back and return slowly.

errores.codosBajos: Pulling with low elbows, like a row.

cues.cadera: Hips high: your body forms an upside-down V.
cues.cabeza: Lower your head toward the floor, in front of your hands.
cues.codos: Elbows going back, not flared to the sides.

errores.cadera: Dropping your hips and turning it into a regular push-up.
errores.golpe: Letting your head hit the floor.

cues.banco: Feet planted on a stable bench, hips high.
cues.cabeza: Lower your head toward the floor, in front of your hands.
cues.progresion: Master the floor pike push-up first.

errores.cadera: Letting your hips drop on the way down.
errores.golpe: Letting your head hit the floor.

cues.bisagra: Hinge at the hips, back straight and knees soft.
cues.abanico: Open your arms in a wide arc up to back height.
cues.ligera: Light weight: the rear delt is a small muscle.

errores.tronco: Lifting your torso to help the lift.
errores.trapecio: Shrugging instead of opening your arms.

cues.inicio: Start with the dumbbells in front of your face, palms facing you.
cues.giro: Open your elbows and turn your palms forward as you press.
cues.abdomen: Abs braced: your arms do the rotation, not your torso.

errores.arco: Arching your back at the top of the press.

cues.pisada: Stand firmly on the band with both feet before starting.
cues.antebrazos: Forearms vertical under your hands the whole way.
cues.abdomen: Abs braced: don't arch your back.

errores.arco: Arching your back to stretch the band.
errores.soltar: Letting the band snap back on the way down.

cues.antebrazos: Forearms vertical under the dumbbells the whole way.
cues.abdomen: Sit tall with abs braced, without leaning back.
cues.arriba: At the top, arms nearly straight, dumbbells over your shoulders.

errores.arco: Leaning back and arching your back.

cues.abdomen: Squeeze your abs and glutes: your torso doesn't arch.
cues.trayectoria: The bar travels straight up from your collarbone to over mid-foot.
cues.cabeza: Move your head back as the bar passes, then under it at lockout.
cues.bloqueo: At the top, arms straight and bar over your shoulders.

errores.arco: Arching your lower back to press.
errores.codos: Starting with your elbows behind the bar.
errores.lejos: Finishing with the bar in front of your head.

cues.antebrazos: Forearms vertical under the dumbbells the whole way.
cues.abdomen: Abs braced and ribs down: don't arch your back.
cues.arriba: At the top, arms nearly straight, dumbbells over your shoulders.

errores.arco: Arching your back to lift more weight.

cues.impulso: Dip your knees slightly and drive hard with your legs.
cues.tronco: Torso vertical during the dip; your heels stay down.
cues.bloqueo: Finish with arms straight and the bar over mid-foot.

errores.sentadilla: Dipping too low, like a squat.
errores.talones: Lifting your heels before you drive.
errores.adelante: Leaning your torso and sending the bar forward.

cues.agarre: Stand on the band and grip it shoulder-width apart.
cues.codos: Lead with your elbows, above your hands.
cues.altura: Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height.

errores.estrecho: Bringing your hands together in the middle.
errores.alto: Raising your elbows above your shoulders.
errores.balanceo: Swinging your torso to stretch the band.

cues.codos: Lead with your elbows, above your hands.
cues.altura: Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height.

errores.estrecho: Gripping the bar with your hands close together.
errores.alto: Raising your elbows above your shoulders.
errores.balanceo: Swinging your torso to lift the weight.

cues.agarre: Dumbbells close to your body, shoulder-width apart.
cues.codos: Lead with your elbows, above your hands.
cues.altura: Stop when your elbows reach shoulder height.

errores.estrecho: Bringing the dumbbells together in the middle.
errores.alto: Raising your elbows above your shoulders.
errores.balanceo: Swinging your torso to lift the weight.

cues.codos: Elbows at shoulder height, slightly forward, and still.
cues.giro: Rotate your forearms up to vertical, no further.
cues.ligera: Light band and slow movement; stop if you feel a sharp pain.

errores.codos: Dropping your elbows during the rotation.
errores.arco: Arching your back to rotate further.

cues.codo: Elbow tight to your side, bent at 90° throughout.
cues.lento: Rotate out slowly and return even more slowly.
cues.ligera: Light band: it's a control exercise, not a strength one.

errores.codo: Moving your elbow away from your body to gain range.
errores.tronco: Rotating your torso instead of your arm.

cues.codo: Elbow tight to your side, bent at 90° throughout.
cues.lento: Bring your hand toward your belly slowly and return with control.
cues.ligera: Light band: it's a control exercise, not a strength one.

errores.codo: Moving your elbow away from your body to gain range.
errores.tronco: Rotating your torso instead of your arm.

cues.altura: Arms straight at shoulder height the whole way.
cues.escapulas: Pull apart by squeezing your shoulder blades, without shrugging.
cues.vuelta: Return slowly to the front, keeping tension.

errores.trapecio: Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.
errores.arco: Arching your back to pull further.
